'''The Storyteller''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Storyteller]], living in the [[Sand People Enclave|Sand People's enclave]] outside [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. He was particularly white dressed, which was unusual among the Sand People. He met [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and told him the history of his tribe.

==Biography==
In [[3956 BBY]], Revan and the crew of the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'' had snuck inside their enclave and managed to negotiate a deal with the [[Sand People chieftain|Chieftain]]. While conversing Revan asked the Chieftain to tell the story of their tribe. However, he refused, stating that only the Storyteller was permitted to tell the history, and that only warriors were permitted to hear it. After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defeated a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]] and returned its [[Krayt dragon pearl/Legends|pearl]] to the Chieftain as proof, he deemed Revan worthy and permitted him to hear the history, with a warning that speaking it in error would be considered blasphemy punishable by death.<ref name="KOTOR" />

Revan then met the Storyteller, who began telling their history, with [[HK-47]] translating. He stated that Tatooine had once been a green and lush world, but with the [[Conquest of Tatooine|arrival]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] and their [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], his people had been conquered. Many were kidnapped. After the Rakata suffered a plague, however, the Sand People rose up against their invaders. The Rakata retaliated by [[Bombardment of Tatooine|bombarding Tatooine]] and the Sand People hid in caves to survive. When the bombardment stopped, the Sand People emerged from the caves and found that the Rakata had left and that Tatooine had become a desert.<ref name="KOTOR" />

The Sand People then became nomads, and new outsiders arrived to mine the [[Ore/Legends|ores]] in Tatooine's ground. The Tusken raiders, remembering the horrors of the Infinite Empire, proceeded to attack their new "invaders".<ref name="KOTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', if the player already did the quest with the moisture-machines, he may bring a dragon pearl from a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] to the chieftain and then The Storyteller will appear, though the player can only talk with the Storyteller if he has [[HK-47]] on his side as a companion. While talking, if the player ignores HK-47's warnings and attempts to contradict his story, they will be seen as committing blasphemy and the entire tribe will become hostile.<ref name="KOTOR" />
